'''Imperial Depot''' was a supply depot used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The Depot had two [[prefab shelter]]s and a [[Factory/Legends|mech factory]] inside the walled enclosure, and was located south of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tunnatutikan]]. After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the site was guarded by two [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], and had four [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]] and one Heavy [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]].<ref name="GB" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}
During the course of the [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|Liberation of Kashyyyk]], it was raided by the Wookiee [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and his associate [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who were allied with the Wookiee forces. The two posed as inspectors to gain access to the depot. One of the stormtroopers asked for authorization, and Chewbacca provided their "authorization:" shots from his [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]]. He then took control of the Imperial [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] and used them in the assault on the communication [[Jammer/Legends|jammers]] in [[Chenachochan]].<ref name="GB" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Depot appears in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' during the Chewbacca campaign. The player has the option of visiting the base to take control of the walkers and use them against the jammers, although the mission may be completed without doing so. This article assumes the player completed all secondary side-quests.<ref name="GB" /> The campaign is also included in the game's [[2002]] expansion pack, ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''.
